thread:
matt: heads-up — deploybot failed promoting the staging image to prod. ECR returned an annotation size error, blocking the push. need a quick decision: retag with trimmed annotations or pin to current prod digest and backfill later? change window tonight 21:00 PST.

deploybot: automatic message: promotion attempt failed. see below.
```
ERROR: PutImage failed: 400 BadRequest
AnnotationPayloadTooLarge: annotations total size 786432 > 65536
Request ID: x-abc-123
Image: registry.redwood.local/redwood/app:staging-2026-03-21-abcdef
BuildID: build-20260321-8765
```

zoe: sounds like the attestation blob is the culprit — we shoved the entire changelog + commit message list into annotations. can we drop that?

jordan: retagging with trimmed annotations is ideal for reproducibility, but it takes time and there's a small risk of consumers seeing a different image tag history. pinning to the previous prod digest is low-risk and keeps prod stable.

sam: +1 to pin for now. pin & create follow-up job to republish a trimmed image in the next maintenance window. we should also update release notes so folks know why the new image didn't promote.

release-eng: agree. please include a short entry in the release notes and the changelog: "promotion held due to oversized provenance metadata; manual republish scheduled." Also flag any SLA-sensitive customers.

anna: ops note — if we pin, I'll flip deploybot to skip auto-promotion for this build and create a manual retag workflow: `/run deploybot retag --source staging-2026-03-21-abcdef --trim-annotations` so we can control the republish.

matt: ok doing pin now. @deploybot set rollout to pinned digest and add release note line: "promotion held due to ECR annotation size limit". we should open an infra ticket to prevent oversized attestations in future.

deploybot: pinned digest set to sha256:1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111. Promotion halted. Created INFRA-5421: "trim provenance annotations on publish to fit ECR limits". Scheduled republish job for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC (off-hours).

jordan: :thumbsup: please also add a brief customer-facing note if any customers asked about this build.

sam: I'll draft the release note blurb now: "Staging image could not be promoted due to oversized attestation metadata. Promotion held; a republish with trimmed metadata is scheduled for 2026-03-22 UTC."

zoe: for the republish job, limit cosign annotations to essential keys only: commit, buildid, short changelog entry (max 256 chars). drop full changelog and extended CI logs.

matt: thanks everyone. plan summary: pin to existing prod digest now, update release notes, create INFRA-5421 to change publish pipeline to trim annotations, schedule manual retag/republish in off-hours. @anna please coordinate the manual retag and keep this thread posted. closing decision for the change window.

anna: will coordinate and post status when republish is done.

matt: closing — feel free to reopen if the republish needs to be accelerated or if any customers impacted. :white_check_mark:
